White text block reads: “Our hearts are with whānau and communities impacted by climate change-charged extreme weather across Te Tai Tokerau and Te Tai Rāwhiti throughout this week, through to last night. Some have lost loved ones. Some are still waiting for news. Others have lost homes, livelihoods and whenua. All of us are connected, and our support is standing by. This clean-up will take a lot of time and effort. We mihi to the regular people, marae, iwi and services who just got things done and looked after each other. These expressions of care and compassion in crisis are exactly what we expect to govern our country. We will be on the ground to help with the clean-up and will continue using every ounce of energy to build resilient, sustainable homes, infrastructure and country we all need and deserve.” 

Signed: “Ngā manaakitanga, Marama Davidson and Chlöe Swarbrick, Green Party Co-Leaders.”

content: SAVE THE DATE: SATURDAY 7 NOVEMBER 🌿
Climate change is not going anywhere and New Zealanders deserve a government that puts climate action, adaptation & strong emergency responses first.

The Government is choosing to increase climate changing emissions and failing to support communities hit first and worst by severe weather. Climate change is increasing the cost of living and wreaking havoc on the livelihoods of our regional communities.
The flooding in Te Tai Tokerau is a climate change charged weather event. The Government will try to tell you that floods like these shouldn't be politicised. But the thing is, this is political.
